rationale: Fix-up (two rounds) resolves all six blocking findings. A blind+edge-case confirmation pass over the fix-up diff surfaced two residuals the first round left open — a catastrophic-backtracking ReDoS that length caps alone did not bound, and an unhashable-item TypeError->500 in the choice branch — both now closed in round two (regex.fullmatch with a hard match-time timeout, a total-payload byte cap, and string-only enforcement on selected items). The confirmation pass's other flags were refuted: the .env/doctor.json churn is uncommitted working-tree noise (verified absent from branch history), and the customer-flag concern targets a new-in-this-MR feature that is intentionally default-off behind the flag with the assistant-form section FE-gated. One noted follow-up: the timeout-capable `regex` module is currently used via its transitive presence in poetry.lock; promoting it to a direct dependency needs a `poetry lock` in an environment with private-registry access (blocked here). 5 lower-severity edge findings (flag not gating the intake path for pre-existing requests, oversized value on validation-less fields, mixed-surface rendering) were triaged to defer.
